item.title: Trying to get back to cut and weight loss ADVICE NEEDED
item.description: First, congrats on the weight loss so far! To your questions: It takes as long as it takes. There’s not really an answer to these questions, and worrying about it will do more harm than good. You had an outcomes-based, not time-bound, goal. Similar to @T3hPwnisher, I’d prefer a daily minimum step count if I were you. Somewhere between 8000 - 12000. Start at 8k and work your way up over many weeks only as needed.
